# WHY THIS FILE EXISTS, and why it is not aliases_src/{lang}_curated.tsv
# The alias index in the bundle is cut from LOINC alone (standardize_build/
# build_bundle.py): it knows LOINC's names, short codes and translations, not
# every phrase a report prints. Both this file and aliases_src/ are read at
# runtime, this one first. The right-hand sides in aliases_src/ are
# descriptive phrases ("Total cholesterol TC", "Leukocyte count WBC") written
# for the 1.4.x index build, and only some of them resolve.
# Here the right-hand side has a stricter job: it must itself be a key the
# alias index can look up. "Total cholesterol TC" reads fine and is a dead end
# The original rows came from mirobody/tests/test_engine_coverage.py; the
# genetic-report rows below are pinned in local report/resolve tests. Two
# kinds of failure appear, and the second is the dangerous one:
#   MISS:  "LDL cholesterol" resolved to nothing. The index is built from
#          LOINC's own designations, so it knows the formal name and the lab
#          short code (LDL-C) but not the phrase humans write. Plain English
#   WRONG: "血红蛋白" resolved to Hemoglobin A1c: a different test, returned
#          with full confidence. It matched 301 index rows and the commonness
#          prior liked HbA1c best. A resolution-rate metric scores this as a
#          success; a patient reading the report would not.
# CONTRIBUTING: this is the lowest-barrier useful PR in the repo. Find a term
# that resolves wrong or not at all, add one row here plus one case in
# mirobody/tests/test_engine_coverage.py. Any language. That module checks
# every row of this file: exactly two fields, no term repeated with another
# target, a target that resolves, a term that then resolves, and a
# deliberate non-answer that refuses with its kind. A typo'd target fails CI
# These names describe a family, specimen or treatment rather than one
# observation. The lexical index can still find a narrow assay whose name
# contains the word, but selecting it would invent the user's intended test.
# `测定` is the assay word a report prints after a name (`尿酸(UA)测定`), never
# a name: alone it answered 41960-6, the type of an HbA1c measurement device.
# A bracket after a name is read as an abbreviation of the SAME analyte
# (`尿酸(UA)测定` -> urate, `UA` resolves to urate on its own too) in
# do not abbreviate anything: each is a METHOD or quantitation flag that
# changes what was ordered, and none has an alias, so the stem-alone
# fallback silently answered through it on main:
#   血型(Rh)测定 -- `Rh` has no alias, so the fallback gave `血型`'s own
#     883-9 (forward ABO group), a typing answer for a reading that named
#   乙肝表面抗原(定量)测定 -- `定量` has no alias either, so the fallback gave
#     the stem's 5196-1, a QUALITATIVE (Ord) code, for a report that said
#     quantitative. `定性` is blocked alongside it for the mirror case: this
#     bundle's HBsAg code happens to already be the qualitative one, so
#     `乙肝表面抗原(定性)测定` was never wrong, but nothing ties that to the
#     word -- some other analyte's default code being the quantitative one
#     is the same bug the other way round.
# `ABO`, `抗体`, `抗原` and `高危型` are NOT here: `血型(ABO)测定` already
# refuses on its own ("two analytes in one name"), since `ABO` carries its
# OWN analyte (1303-7, different from `血型`'s 883-9) rather than falling
# through with no alias at all; blocking it would only cost bare `ABO`'s
# own answer. `高危型` coincides with bare HPV's own code, and `抗体`/`抗原`
# have no alias and no observed case where the fallback answered wrong.
# `C13`/`C14` are NOT here either, on purpose: unlike `Rh`, they are real
# printed test names in their own right -- tetradecanoylcarnitine (`C14`,
# 30565-6) and its C13 neighbour, both on an acylcarnitine or newborn-
# screening panel, next to `C16`/`C18` in the same family. Blocking the bare
# term would abstain those panels to guard one bracket shape. 幽门螺杆菌
# (C14)测定 / 幽门螺杆菌(C13)测定 (a urea-breath-test isotope paired with
# H. pylori) and 尿素呼气试验(C14) all still abstain without the block: `C14`
# and `C13` resolve to the carnitine analyte, a different one than either
# stem (17859-0 H. pylori IgG Ab, 29891-9 urea breath test), so
# `OfflineResolver.resolve`'s own "two analytes in one name" check refuses
# them -- the same path that already protects `血型(ABO)测定`, not a
# for the pinned proof that this is the path, not an accident of ranking.
# A checkup's physical-exam rows are named by body site or department, with
# a finding for a value (`胸廓 对称`). Each answered an unrelated assay:
# 胸廓 a breast aspirate's microscopy, 口腔 a 1-hour glucose challenge.
# The bare plural nouns (Leukocytes, Erythrocytes, Hematocrit) are not index
# keys on their own; the LOINC short names are. "HCT" alone is not usable as
# a target either — it collides with Calcitonin.
# The British spelling is an index key on 403 rows, and the commonness prior
# picked 4548-4 Hemoglobin A1c from them: the 血红蛋白 failure at the top of
# this file, in English. `Haemoglobin (Hb)` was refused as two analytes for the
# same reason. Found by a keyword-recall probe on 2026-10-06.
